title: Take part in our research
intro: People with lived experience help shape Toynbee Hall’s research, from deciding what questions to ask through to sharing findings and recommendations.

blocks.heading: Research shaped with communities
paragraphs: Our participatory action research approach values community knowledge and supports peer researchers to lead research that can influence services and policy.

blocks.heading: Get in touch
paragraphs: Email research@toynbeehall.org.uk to ask about current opportunities to take part.
